history.summary: 13-acre (5.2 hectare) temple-and-garden complex in Civil Township, Rourkela, managed by the Hanuman Vatika Trust Board. It was renovated and inaugurated in 1994 by the then Chief Minister of Odisha, Biju Patnaik. Its centrepiece is a 75-ft (23 m) Hanuman statue built by Sri Lakshman Swami of Hyderabad, reported among the tallest Hanuman statues; the complex also has 12 Jyotirlinga shrines, Batta Mangala, Sarala Devi, Jagannath, Lakshmi, Santoshi Mata, Vinayaka, Vaishno Devi and Shiva shrines, plus a later-added Sai Baba temple (idol modelled on Shirdi's). A Kalyan Mandap on campus hosts weddings and social functions. Foundation day is celebrated every year on 23 February.

name: Hanuman Vatika
town_description: Rourkela is an industrial metropolis in Sundargarh district, northwestern Odisha, known as the 'Steel City' for the Rourkela Steel Plant commissioned in the 1950s. It sits near the confluence of the Shankh and Koel rivers that form the Brahmani. Beyond industry, it has become a tourist base for Vedvyas, Hanuman Vatika and the surrounding tribal hinterland of the Chotanagpur plateau.
